title: The capacity band does not hold the charge between the BMS stops
found: On 200 synthetic packs the monthly 90 % band held the charge between the stops at the date in 2278 of 4782 month ends (48 %); the estimate reads +0.47 points of nominal capacity above it on average. Against the capacity between the rest voltages it reports, the band held 4248 of 4562 (93 %), -0.04 points on average; that truth was chosen after the first results.

title: Partial windows are not covered
found: Storage that works at a middle state of charge gives no full-to-empty pairs and so no capacity. This comes after the pack simulator (besslib.sim).

title: Apparent charge loss (A4) was biased
